evidence.title: Canopy: README.md
evidence.finding: Desktop starts local controller/Postgres/gateway/worker; server Compose browser access grants owner authority to anyone who reaches it. Remote pairing connects existing infrastructure. Successor to canopy-desktop.

evidence.title: Canopy: LICENSE.md
evidence.finding: Custom March2026 terms permit free personal/commercial use and reading source, but modification/fork/redistribution require written permission; not an open-source license.

evidence.title: Canopy: docs/architecture.md
evidence.finding: The architecture describes Claude Agent SDK, Codex app-server and the shared ACP client for Grok/Antigravity worker sessions. Owner/device authentication is implemented; user login, organization tenancy and admin visibility remain open design decisions. Source behavior is not a promise of stable-release parity.

evidence.title: Canopy: docs/mobile.md
evidence.finding: iOS TestFlight access requires invitation; Android APK built manually. Optional usage ping is separate from provider traffic.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/desktop/package.json
evidence.finding: Electron desktop dependencies/scripts wrap web and controller; separate Bun gateway/worker and Svelte web packages.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/api/auth.ts
evidence.finding: Process listener service bearer and paired revocable device tokens resolve one owner; revocation rechecks/aborts active streams. Not personal organization RBAC.

evidence.title: Canopy: packages/domain/src/agent-bus/policy.ts
evidence.finding: Owner/project/tree-scoped communication and descendant control; defaults depth1,8children,16active tree,256hops,10schedules,30day recurrence and5min minimum cron. Fork requires same provider instance.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/mcp-bus.ts
evidence.finding: Thread-scoped loopback HTTP MCP requires fresh bearer, bounds methods and dispatches platform tools; Codex also uses dynamic tools, ACP providers receive MCP.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/core/core-queue.ts
evidence.finding: Native queued-turn edit/reorder/remove/undo and steering use owner checks and expected revisions. Queue items are prompts, not independent issues.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/core/scheduler.ts
evidence.finding: Gateway ticks every5s, batches50, claims180s leases, applies timezone/missed-run policy and keeps service running independently of UI.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/store/bus-schedules.ts
evidence.finding: SQL transaction fences occurrence/version/lease, skip-if-running, until/maxruns, worker placement retry4s; explicit new-thread and existing-thread modes.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/connectors/issue-providers.ts
evidence.finding: Fixed read-only Linear/Jira/GitHub issue lookup normalizes durable URL/key/title/body/status; this search path does not synchronize issue mutations.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/bots/approval-rules.ts
evidence.finding: Native bot action allowlist and exact grants; dangerous configuration/create/delete/permission operations always ask, even full-auto.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/claude/permissions.ts
evidence.finding: ASK default interactive; ACCEPT_EDITS, readonly and FULL_AUTO sandbox differ. FULL_ACCESS disables sandbox/autoallows; Windows FULL_AUTO cannot supply the same OS boundary.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/codex/permissions.ts
evidence.finding: ASK readOnly/on-request; acceptedits workspaceWrite/on-request; FULL_AUTO workspaceWrite/never; FULL_ACCESS danger-full-access/never.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/sandbox-support.ts
evidence.finding: Verified custom profiles require Linux/bwrap and pinned custom CLIProxyAPI configurations; Claude also socat, exact domains supported; Codex offline only. Native auth/extra args/Grok/Antigravity do not qualify.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/claude/sandbox-profile.ts
evidence.finding: Profile hash/endpoint binding, failIfUnavailable, strict domains/no local bindings and rejection of dynamic hooks/plugins/proxy settings.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/codex/sandbox-profile.ts
evidence.finding: Private0700home, exactversion, configlayer validation and Linux enforcement; unverified native account configuration rejected.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/providers/antigravity/launch.ts
evidence.finding: Native agyACP process/session, minimum1.5.16, no extraargs, private configuration and telemetry/updates disabled; FULL_AUTO rejected.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/worktrees/core-worktrees.ts
evidence.finding: Native worker command creates owned worktrees and branches, serializes preparation and records relation to workspace/thread.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/worktrees/lifecycle.ts
evidence.finding: Durable removal IDs survive reconnect; external worktrees cannot be removed; local branch deletion requires narrower current permission and supported worker receipt.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/store/outbox.ts
evidence.finding: Durable command IDs, expiry, owner admission and connection epochs fence dispatch; bounded pages2048/about512KiB; cleanup intents have special expiry semantics.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/github/create.ts
evidence.finding: PR create preflights published checkouthead/base/account/access and owner confirmation.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/github/mutations.ts
evidence.finding: Prepared idempotency receipts bind account/accessrevision/head/action fingerprint, confirm and send once; ambiguous writes become uncertain, not blindly retried.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/github/lifecycle.ts
evidence.finding: Merge/auto-merge/queue/updatebranch/close/reopen require current head/baseSHA, live permissions/checks and expectedHeadOid or RESTsha.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/web/src/lib/features/github/ReviewForm.svelte
evidence.finding: Native comment/approve/request-changes form with retained drafts, stalehead acknowledgement, confirmed/uncertain receipts, own-author restrictions and offline blocking.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/runtime/usage-limits.ts
evidence.finding: Plan allowance queries use own native account only, excludeAPI/baseURL configurations and discard stale changed profile data.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/worker/src/runtime/thread-secrets.ts
evidence.finding: Leased secret files outside workspace, private0700/0600, startup cleanup and currentturn/expiry guards. SameUID or copied values remain outside guarantee.

evidence.title: Canopy: docs/secrets.md
evidence.finding: Manual leaseTTL24h; revocation asynchronous/offline expiry; exact/string-escaped redaction does not recall copies or guarantee transformed secret removal. Grok native logs may retain values.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/maintenance/thread-retention.ts
evidence.finding: Archived auto-purge default0/off; configurable days,31day manually deleted retention, dependency/fork protection, locking and irreversible purged state before bounded cleanup.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/gateway/src/maintenance/storage.ts
evidence.finding: Unused upload30days, unreferenced blob7days, quarantine7days; protected references prevent deletion, bounded SQL batches and hashlocks.

evidence.title: Canopy: packages/domain/src/usage-ping.ts
evidence.finding: Explicit anonymous Umami send endpoint analytics.itsol.tech/api/send receives version/OS/arch/language/screen; timeout10s/retry15min.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/desktop/src/usage-ping.ts
evidence.finding: Packaged-only daily usage ping requires explicit recordedconsent ANDenabled; absent/olddefaulton/unreadable file optsout; persistent local setting.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/mobile/src/state/usage-ping.tsx
evidence.finding: Paired foreground network opt-in daily ping; devskip, immediate preference handling; SecureStore defaultoff.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/web/src/lib/features/desktop/UsagePingSettings.svelte
evidence.finding: In-app desktop ping setting calls bridge; standalone web has no desktop ping bridge.

evidence.title: Canopy: apps/desktop/src/updates.ts
evidence.finding: Packaged signedMac/AppImage/Windows supported update checking; scheduleminutes0 disablesautomatic, startup respects preference; sourcebuild/package-manager scope differs.

evidence.finding: Open design decisions include user login, organization tenancy and admin visibility. These planned capabilities are not established by diagrams.
